title: vosu.skin
description: Best-effort, declared common namespace (ADR 0020): the client's current skin. Capability id: field:vosu.skin(.<path>).

name.description: Display name of the current skin, as the client names it.

tree.description: Indexed folder reference for the skin's files (ADR 0021), e.g. `resource:skin`. `null` when the plugin does not fill this field or the active skin has no browsable files (a built-in skin with no export folder).
